name: eec-audit

scripts.embed: npm run embed:stage0 && npm run embed:stage1 && npm run embed:stage2

scripts.glossary: npm run glossary:stage0 && npm run glossary:stage1 && npm run glossary:stage2

scripts.all: npm run drift && npm run wrappers && npm run anatomy && npm run dial && npm run immersion && npm run bidi
